## Idea of Dimensions


## What Does Gaussian Noise look like?

```{r}
sigma <- matrix(c(4,1,1,1,4,1,1,1,4), ncol = 3, nrow = 3)
mean = c(0,0,0 )
#sigma
#mean
rmvnorm(n=500, mean=mean, sigma=sigma, method="chol")
data_3d <- mvtnorm::rmvnorm(mean = mean, n = 1000, sigma = sigma) %>%
  as_tibble() |> janitor::clean_names()

# 2D density on x-y
kd <- kde2d(data_3d$v1, data_3d$v2, n = 100)

# put the density on the xy plane at the minimum z
z0 <- min(data_3d$v3)

data_3d |> plot_ly(x = ~v1, y = ~v2, z = ~v3) |> 
  add_trace(type = "scatter3d", mode = "markers", size = 3) |> add_surface(
    x = kd$x,
    y = kd$y,
    z = matrix(z0, nrow = length(kd$y), ncol = length(kd$x)),
    surfacecolor = t(kd$z),
    colorscale = "Viridis",
    opacity = 0.5,
    showscale = FALSE,
    contours = list(
      z = list(show = "truehist")
    )
  )

```


```{r}

p2 <- data_3d |> ggplot(aes(x = v1, y = v2, z = v3)) + 
  ggcube::geom_point_3d() + 
  coord_3d()+ 
  # place 2D density plot on zmin face
  stat_density_2d(position = position_on_face(faces = "zmin", axes = c("x", "y")),
                      geom = "polygon", alpha = .1, linewidth = .25) + 
  stat_density_2d(position = position_on_face(faces = "ymin", axes = c("x", "z")),
                      geom = "polygon", alpha = .1, linewidth = .25)

p2
# animate_3d(p2)

```
